verdict.rationale: Sumsub is an identity-verification and KYC/AML SaaS platform, not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Its documented MCP server (sumsub-docs-4, sumsub-probe-3) is the server role, letting outside agents call Sumsub; that is a separate story and cannot be credited here. Nothing in the pack shows Summy AI or any other feature accepting user-supplied MCP servers.
